name: voicepack
description: A portable persona engine that stops brand voice from decaying inside AI agents. Compiles a token-budgeted voice pack from a JSON persona store, and critiques drafts against it.

scripts.pack: node bin/voicepack.mjs pack --dir examples/demo --profile demo --channel instagram --intent launch
scripts.check: node bin/voicepack.mjs check --dir examples/demo --profile demo --channel instagram --file examples/demo/profiles/demo/exemplars/instagram/2026-08-14-five-thousand-loaves.md
